name: ls-mcp
description: Lightspeed Retail (R-Series) data as MCP tools — sales, orders, workorders, items, customers, and more.
long_description: Exposes Lightspeed Retail (R-Series) API V3 data as MCP tools: sales, purchase orders, workorders, catalog items, customers, vendors, employees, categories, manufacturers, and shops. Read-only by default; item creation/updates are available as an opt-in. Credentials are stored encrypted by Claude Desktop, not in a plaintext file.

client_id.title: Lightspeed Client ID
client_id.description: OAuth client ID from your Lightspeed API client (aka LIGHTSPEED_USERNAME).

client_secret.title: Lightspeed Client Secret
client_secret.description: OAuth client secret from your Lightspeed API client (aka LIGHTSPEED_PASS).

refresh_token.title: Lightspeed Refresh Token
refresh_token.description: OAuth refresh token (aka LIGHTSPEED_OAUTH_REFRESH_TOKEN). Revoked if the API client is reset in Lightspeed.

enable_writes.title: Enable write tools
enable_writes.description: Turns on create_item/update_item, which can mutate your live store. Off by default — everything else is always read-only.
